feed.title: Goodyear, Blizzard, Roku, Slim Jim Get Behind Jimothy Raccoon 07/28/2026
feed.summary: Brands like Goodyear, Blizzard, Roku, and Slim Jim are leveraging the viral fame of 'Jimothy Raccoon,' a rotund raccoon from Seattle, in their marketing efforts. feed.title: Rethinking security for the age of AI

feed.title: In-house legal departments underestimate how much AI will change their role - Gartner analyst
feed.summary: A Gartner analyst, Raashi Rastogi, states that in-house legal departments are underestimating the significant impact AI will have on their roles. Legal departments need to actively reinvent themselves in response to these technological shifts and other trends like regulatory uncertainty and changes in legal recruitment.
